plain_statement.zh: 证明归一化大弧系数不会有正比例集中在任意足够窄的实区间内。
plain_statement.en: Prove uniform anti-concentration for the actual major-arc coefficient.

brief.zh: #4275 的尖锐下界并不给出系数取值的集中度。可截取有限个素数，用 CRT 比较独立整除事件，再控制剩余局部因子的影响。需要对区间中心 z 一致；仅证明单点不等于下界不够。
brief.en: Transfer to products over finitely many primes, control the discarded tail, and prove absence of atoms using independent prime divisibility. The scale must work simultaneously for all interval centers.
